verdicts.note: 2026-08-27 Letter confirms 'Quasi Dynamic Server Meshing' naming, 4.10 instancing as first dynamic-meshing use case, PU territories not yet subdivided, servers spun up at a max load ratio. The ~500-player 4.0 shard figure was not in this run's extracts (prior/earlier-pass knowledge). Letter also moves Squadron 42 to Q2 2027.
CCP: M2-XFE peaked at 6,739 pilots, breaking FWST-8's 6,557; combined peak 13,770 across three Delve systems at ~23:23 EVE time (~35% of all online). Record set 3 Jan 2021. No source shows 8,825.

Improbable/Midwinter PR: peak 4,144 players in one world at ScavLab 'Winter Sports' event, 29 May 2021. TechCrunch: ~4,500 in Yuga 'First Trip' scripted demo. GamesBeat: Second Trip (2022) count undisclosed, capacity stated as 10,000. Morpheus 'over 10,000' is the April 2022 announcement. No 2024-25 10k event surfaced. The cited mcvuk 'Tennis for Two Thousand' URL did not appear in results; use the PR as source.

Fireworks AI acquired Hathora (announced 4 Mar 2026); platform frozen same day; support ended 5 May 2026 (Crux) / 'end of April' (Frost Giant); customers offboarded to Nitrado GameFabric; Stormgate lost online multiplayer (announced 1 Apr 2026); Splitgate 2 and Predecessor also affected. Post-May Stormgate status unknown; Crux/Gameye are competing vendors.

Edgegap blog: vCPU raised from $0.001 to $0.00115/min from 1 Jan 2025; egress 'remains at $0.10 per GB'; fractional to 1/4 vCPU; 20%/30% commit discounts. AWS GameLift Servers pricing page: c6i.large $0.109/h Linux On-Demand, US East (Ohio), 2 vCPU/4 GiB (https://aws.amazon.com/gamelift/servers/pricing/). Caveat: Edgegap Fleets pages now advertise no egress fees for private fleets; blog is not a live rate card.

Delisted from Steam 25 Jul 2025; Novaquark shut the MMO server Wed 27 Aug 2025 at 14:00 UTC (mein-mmo quoting forum); unused sub time refunded; myDU standalone continues (on sale June 2026 per MassivelyOP).

Partly confirmed: DataStore budget 60 + 10 x players per server confirmed by Roblox docs/forum; DevForum confirms the 700-player program can no longer be publicly joined (one dev hosted 400; profile cites 671 seated). NOT covered by extracts: the '200 since 24 Jul 2024' date and the 30-request per-key queue; no official max-server-size page found and one low-authority FAQ says 100. A 2026 forum post claims a future 250 + 40 x CCU limit (unconfirmed).

Photon: free 100 CCU for Fusion/Quantum (up from 20), commercial use, one app; Plus = 100 paid + 100 free = 200 CCU at $95/yr (blog.photonengine.com). ODIN: EUR0.29/PCU-month for 1-19,999 PCU, EUR0.19 above 80k, free to 25 CCU; also EUR19.90/mo plan incl. 100 CCU. Discord Social SDK GA 13 Aug 2025 (discord.com press release); 'free' only from a secondary article. 'Fusion 2 >200 players/room' not in extracts (prior knowledge).

Week-26 (27 Jun 2025) Project Zero UG summary: Firestorm Zero shut down 'for the time being'; refunds issued; reasons = maintaining two streaming products and provider-required migration of Project Zero to a new platform; may return later. Launched 14 Mar 2025 on Amazon GameLift at L$250 per 5 hours. No exact closure date; blog source, not an LL announcement.

Correction: per an Epic staff forum reply, Iris moved from Experimental to BETA in UE 5.7 and is compiled in by default, but remains disabled by default (net.Iris.UseIrisReplication) so it is still opt-in; Epic has no plans to deprecate legacy replication or Replication Graph. The 'still Experimental' label (StraySpark blog) is out of date. Fortnite: 40v40 'Big Battle - Zero Build' (80 players) launched v22.40 Nov 2022 (research file says v21.40) and was pulled quickly; 50v50 has not returned; standard 100/instance stands (Epic Iris docs, earlier pass).

additional_findings: The 27 Aug 2026 Letter from the Chairman also retargets Squadron 42 to Q2 2027; 4.10 Siege of Orison instances are closed to the player and party (up to four).

Edgegap's current Fleets pages advertise 'no egress fees' for private fleets and point to a live rate card at edgegap.com/pricing.md; the US$0.00115/min and US$0.10/GB figures come from the Jan-2025 blog, not a live rate card.
Hathora timeline: announced 4 Mar 2026, platform frozen same day, support ended 5 May 2026; Stormgate's online status after May 2026 was not found.

Roblox DataStore API reference exposes per-server override limits (base 0-60, per-player 0-40); a 2026 DevForum post claims a coming change to 250 + 40 x concurrent users (unconfirmed by Roblox); one developer measured a 300 budget on a 1-player server versus 70 predicted by docs.
ODIN also sells a EUR19.90/month subscription including 100 concurrent users (EUR0.29 per additional user); PAYG drops to EUR0.19 above 80,000 PCU; VAT may apply.
Research file attributes Fortnite's 40v40 Big Battle - Zero Build to v21.40; coverage says v22.40 (Nov 2022).
myDU (Dual Universe standalone) was still sold in June 2026 (US$25 sale) and some community servers persist.
The mcvuk 'Tennis for Two Thousand' URL cited for claim 2 did not surface in search; the Improbable/Midwinter PR of 1 June 2021 is the primary source for the 4,144 figure.
